detail.title: CP-UNP-F4551L30-DPQ
detail.overview: 5MP WDR 45x IR Network PTZ Camera- 300 Mtr.
features: AI Instastream, Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264H, H.264B, MJPEG
WDR(120dB), 2D NR/ 3D NR, Day/Night(ICR), ROI, Defog, AWB, AGC, BLC, HLC
Up to 300 Presets, 5 Scan, 8 Tour, 5 Pattern
CMS Software: KVMS Pro Lite, EVMS Pro

General.Minimum Illumination: 0.005 lux@F1.6 (Color, 30 IRE), 0.0005 lux@F1.6 (B/W, 30 IRE), 0 lux@F1.6 (IR on)
General.White Balance: Auto, Indoor, Outdoor, ATW, Manual, Sodium lamp, Natural, Street lamp
General.Pan & Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless, Tilt: –20° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 Areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view
General.Special Features: Up to 300 Presets, 5 Pattern, 8  (up to 32 presets per tour) Tour, 5 Scan
General.OSD: Camera title, Date & Time, PTZ Coordinate, Zoom, North, Pattern, Temperature, Preset,  Loca-tion, Input Text, Text Alignment, Privacy Masking, Time Title, Font Properties, Custom  Title, Exception Overlay
General.Video Compression: AI Instastream, Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264H, H.264B MJPEG (Sub Stream)
General.Audio Compression: PCM, G.711a, G.711Mu, G.726, AAC, MPEG2-Layer2, G722.1
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture, Recording, send email, Preset, Tour, Pattern, Alarm digital output
General.Tracking Trigger Event: Crossing virtual fence, Tripwire, Intrusion, Abandoned Object, Fast Moving, Parking Detection,  Loitering Detection
General.Alarm Event: Motion/tampering detection, Defocus Detection, Audio detection, SD Card Exception (No SD  card, Low SD card space, SD card error), Network Exception (Offline, IP Conflict), External  Alarm, IMD, Security Warning, AI Events

General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Crossing Virtual Fence, Tripwire, Intrusion, Object Abandon, Fast Moving, Parking Detection,  Crowd Gathering, Missing Object, Loitering Detection, Calibration Verification, Face Detection
General.Cyber Security: AES 256-bit Encryption, Configuration encryption, trusted execution, Digest, security logs,  WSSE, account lockout, syslog, video encryption, 802.1x, Allow list/Block list, HTTPS, trusted  upgrade, trusted boot, firmware encryption
